Data.String: Cell removal (D-025, D-038): disc-stack centrifuges S-301A to C, two running, one spare, each on FIC-3011x; the self-cleaning bowl discharges the cell mass intermittently into V-301; operating water, motors and CIP by the vendor (ASSUMED).
Acidulation (D-007, D-038): 93 wt% H2SO4 by FFIC-3021 in ratio to FT-3020 (1.01 mol per mol Ca), trimmed by AIC-3024 (pH about 2.5, ASSUMED), into R-301 near the impeller.
2.0 MW of dilution and reaction heat to CW through the pump-around P-303A/B and the spiral cooler E-301 on TIC-3023; LIC-3022 sets the P-305A/B speed (VFD).

Gypsum (D-038): horizontal vacuum belt filter S-302 with cloth wash, no cake wash (D-007); filtrate receiver V-303 on the liquid-ring vacuum pumps K-301A/B (seal water by the vendor); cake 20 wt% moisture to the belt conveyor.
